games.name: Terrible Mouse: The Disaster
games.desc:
Terrible Mouse: The Disaster is an asymmetrical survival game inspired by other games in the genre, such as Forsaken and Sonic.exe TD.


The game consists of two teams: survivors and killers.

The survivors' role is to survive and complete objectives on the maps to reduce the round time and escape.
The killers' role is to prevent the survivors from escaping.

(The game is in alpha, so bugs are likely.)

games.name: Subterra ⛏️ [BETA]
games.desc:
Welcome to Subterra ⛏️! 
It's a 2.5 dimensional mining game with a procedurally generated world where you dig deeper, upgrade your pickaxe and survive layers that get more hostile the further you descend.

❓ [ How to Play ]
- Mine ores and upgrade your pickaxe to go even deeper.
- Build your character with Ability Cards.
- Craft Weapons that help you defeat monsters.
- Obtain rare recipes of weapons and potions.
- Explore various layers.
- Defeat Monsters and Bosses!

💻 [ Controls ]
- E to open Inventory
- C to Interact
- F to Block/Parry
- Left Mouse to Mine

💾 [BETA] 
The game is still under development, expect various changes. 
If you find bugs or have suggestions let us know in the community server!

Thank you for playing!

games.name: [🖼️ MUSEUM] Chameleon
games.desc:
🎨 CHAMELEON

Blend in. Paint yourself. Trick the seekers.

Chameleon is a hide and seek painting game inspired by Meccha Chameleon, where hiders use colors, brushes, and smart camouflage to survive while seekers hunt them down with abilities.

Paint your character to match the map, hide in plain sight, use taunts, freeze in place, and outplay the seekers before time runs out.

Join our group for updates, rewards, codes, testing access, and future content drops.

Controls:
B Brush
G Fill
C Color Picker
Q Undo
E Redo
F Freeze
T Taunt
R Abilities
